purpose: Turn the approved Weather Context hourly data seam into the accepted FT-003 forecast session while preserving city-timezone rules, shared card presentation and the registered capability boundaries.
success_outcome: A clean build and deterministic redacted evidence prove that Today opens exactly the complete eight-slot hourly view, renders the accepted two-by-four shared cards, applies the common exit flow and rejects missing data with the exact message without direct storage/provider bypass or scope expansion.

Stop if a provider or verification path requires a live key, unredacted artifact, live external request or evidence outside the accepted disposable/isolation route.

constraints: Forecast Sessions owns user-facing hourly session entry/rejection, transient state, timing and gestures; Weather Context owns provider normalization, complete hourly data and the availability predicate.
Main Display supplies Today intent and renders the returned projection; it does not access Weather Context storage or raw provider fields.
Selected-city API timezone drives hourly labels and day boundaries; device timezone remains the Main Display clock/date source.
Required hourly data is all-or-nothing; no partial sequence, invented slot or fabricated field may open a session.
Hourly cards reuse the accepted static pseudo-glass and illustration rules and omit pressure arrows; no second material or trend rule is introduced.
The composition root and MainActivity may only wire/render existing boundaries; business orchestration remains in Forecast Sessions.
Provider and test paths use synthetic/redacted credentials only; no live key or secret-bearing evidence is permitted.

FT-003-AC-005 / REQ-009 / REQ-026: incomplete required fields create no session, invent no slot and show `Почасовой прогноз еще не подгрузился`.
